title: alternanthera diffusa
intro: Alternanthera diffusa, commonly known as "Kalmegh" or "Andrographis paniculata", is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alternanthera diffusa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include andrographolides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
